# googleworkspace_dlp_organization_scope (Data Source)

Returns the customer-wide scope identifier required by Cloud Identity DLP policies. The identifier represents the Workspace organization root in DLP PolicyQuery; it is not the Workspace customer ID. Requires the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.orgunit.readonly` OAuth scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "googleworkspace_dlp_organization_scope" "current" {}

output "organization_scope_id" {
  value = data.googleworkspace_dlp_organization_scope.current.organization_scope_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `organization_scope_id` (String) The root organization scope ID to use as `org_unit_id` on a `googleworkspace_dlp_detector`.
